entries.heading: Of the unobligated balances available within the ``DOD-VA
ancestors: DIVISION I—MILITARY CONSTRUCTION AND VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2015
entries.text:
Sec. 240.  Of the unobligated balances available within the ``DOD-VA 
Health Care Sharing Incentive Fund'', $15,000,000 are hereby rescinded.

entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION K—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2015
TITLE II—DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT
entries.text:
Sec. 240.  None of the funds made available by this Act may be used 
to terminate the status of a unit of general local government as a 
metropolitan city (as defined in section 102 of the Housing and 
Community Development Act of 1974 (42 U.S.C. 5302)) with respect to 
grants under section 106 of such Act (42 U.S.C. 5306).
